input.quote: Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party. Except for termination for material breach as detailed in paragraph 4(b), Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement,
input.rationale: Paragraph 4(a) gives AP no convenience right at all during the Initial Term (a 12-month lock-in on an agreement that auto-renews indefinitely), while granting Kubient a symmetrical for-any-reason right after the Initial Term exercisable at any time on 90 days' notice — the reverse of the playbook allocation. It also strips AP of its revenue share by giving Kubient all fees generated during the notice period, functioning as an early-termination penalty. Redline adds a 30-day AP convenience right with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, confines Kubient's convenience right to the end of the then-current term on 90 days' notice, and removes the fee forfeiture; fallback of 60 days' notice offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Add AP convenience termination on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund; limit Kubient's convenience right to end of term; remove fee forfeiture on termination
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a customer right to terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' notice with a pro-rata refund of any prepaid fees, and limited Kubient's convenience right to the end of the then-current term on ninety (90) days' notice, since as drafted we are locked in for the Initial Term while Kubient may walk away after it. We also removed Kubient's entitlement to all fees generated during the notice period so that termination carries no penalty; if helpful, we can accept 60 days' notice instead of 30.

ops.newText: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Exhibit for convenience, in whole or in part, at any time upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Kubient, in which case Kubient shall refund any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Kubient may not terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term or any renewal term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit, and may terminate this Agreement for convenience only effective at the end of the then-current term upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice to Customer. Each Party shall remain entitled to its share of revenue generated during the notice period in accordance with paragraph 5 and the applicable Exhibit, and no early-termination fee or other penalty shall be payable by Customer in connection with any termination,
